title: Fig. 3: Gemini GT-4 Experiment D-1 Basic Object Photography camera equipment
description: Photograph captioned "D-1 BASIC OBJECT PHOTOGRAPHY" showing an array of photo-optical equipment laid out on a surface, including cameras, long telephoto lenses, a handgrip mount and film accessories. It accompanies text in NASA document M-913-65-04 (dated 5/24/65) describing the GT-4 experiment to evaluate astronauts' ability to observe, track and photograph objects in space such as the launch vehicle second stage and celestial bodies. The upper half of the page is text on spacecraft modifications for GT-4.
